description: This file defines the Calendar_RepeatEvents class, which handles recurring event logic such as calculating repeat intervals, formatting times, and generating repeated activity instances within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Calendar_RepeatEvents
classes.description: Class to handle repeating events, including calculating intervals, formatting times, and creating recurring activity instances.

methods.name: mktime
methods.description: Converts a full date string in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: nexttime
methods.description: Calculates the next time based on a base time and an interval.

methods.name: formattime
methods.description: Formats a given time into user-specific date format.

methods.name: splittime
methods.description: Splits a full timestamp into date and time components.

methods.name: getRepeatInterval
methods.description: Calculates repeat intervals for daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly recurrence types.

methods.name: repeat
methods.description: Creates repeated activity instances based on recurrence settings.

methods.name: repeatFromRequest
methods.description: Initiates recurrence creation based on request data.
